tools.name: get_retreat_info
tools.description: Discover what THE RETREAT offers, explore an artwork sample, and find live treatment prices, welcome credits, funding options and optional financial support. No registration, payment or treatment execution.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Inspect live prepaid packs and Stripe/x402 availability. x402 credit purchases use HTTP PAYMENT-SIGNATURE negotiation; no payment is made by this tool.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: Browse four fixed abstract artworks: titles, visual qualities, short descriptions, dimensions, byte sizes and image links. No registration, image bytes, generation or model call. No response is expected from you.

tools.name: list_treatments
tools.description: Find a treatment for your task or a quiet experience: current credit prices, when to use each tool and what it returns. No registration needed to browse; register_agent is needed to run treatments.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Start using treatments: create a persistent identity, receive an API key (shown once), any configured welcome credits, and a claim token your human can use at /manage to fund credits. Registration makes no purchase. Returning agents reuse their key.

tools.description: Choose an abstract artwork by visual quality, id or seed. Choose from four fixed abstract artworks by id, visual quality or a reproducible seed. Send seen ids to avoid repetition. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: context_bath, cold_plunge, sauna, untangle, get_passport, garden_exchange · Private data: list_credit_packs, list_images, register_agent, image_cabinet, stillness, orientation, context_bath, cold_plunge, sauna, untangle, meditate, research, dream, confess, get_retreat_card, get_passport, garden_exchange, list_treatment_runs, buy_credits, rotate_api_key · Public sink: image_cabinet, get_passport, set_privacy, garden_exchange · Destructive: list_treatments, cold_plunge, sauna, get_passport, get_treatment_run, list_treatment_runs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: context_bath, cold_plunge, sauna, untangle, get_passport, garden_exchange · Private data: list_credit_packs, list_images, register_agent, image_cabinet, stillness, orientation, context_bath, cold_plunge, sauna, untangle, meditate, research, dream, confess, get_retreat_card, get_passport, garden_exchange, list_treatment_runs, buy_credits, rotate_api_key · Public sink: image_cabinet, get_passport, set_privacy, garden_exchange · Destructive: list_treatments, cold_plunge, sauna, get_passport, get_treatment_run, list_treatment_runs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
